[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-3ce9a9.svg)](LICENSE) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/manifest-json/v/Sandeepgaddam5432/autobatch-extension?label=version&color=blue)](https://github.com/Sandeepgaddam5432/autobatch-extension/releases/latest) [![Build](https://github.com/Sandeepgaddam5432/autobatch-extension/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Sandeepgaddam5432/autobatch-extension/actions) [![Manifest V3](https://img.shields.io/badge/manifest-v3-8957e5.svg)](manifest.json) [Install](#-install) · [Quick start](#-quick-start) · [Features](#-features) · [Platforms](#-supported-platforms) · [Prompt sources](#-prompt-sources) · [Filenames](#-filename-tokens) · [Troubleshooting](#-troubleshooting) · [Architecture](#-architecture) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)
--- ## Why? Generating media on AI platforms is a manual grind: paste a prompt, wait, click download, rename the file, repeat ×200. UnQ Automation turns that into a queue — load your prompts (typed, `.txt`, `.csv` or `.xlsx`), press **Run**, and walk away. The extension types, submits, waits for results, downloads them with your naming scheme, and keeps going even while the tab sits in the background. Everything runs **locally, inside your own logged-in browser session**. No server, no API keys, no data leaves your machine — it automates the same web pages you already use by hand. ## ✨ Features ### Prompt engine - Type prompts directly (separated by blank lines) or import `.txt`, `.csv`, `.tsv`, `.xlsx` - `{{variable}}` templating with cartesian expansion (up to 2,000 combinations per run) - Global prefix/suffix, repeat count, shuffle and de-duplication - Per-row overrides in spreadsheets: `image`, `ratio`, `mode`, `outputs` columns - Attach input images with flexible pairing (one per prompt, first for all, every image × every prompt, start + end frames) - **Characters**: named reference images that auto-attach whenever a prompt mentions their name ### Queue engine - 1–4 concurrent lanes with staggered starts - Randomised delay range between submissions for human-like pacing - Automatic retries with backoff (default 5) plus one-click retry per item - Abort after N consecutive failures; configurable per-item timeout (default 5 min) - Pause / resume / stop at any time; queue snapshot persisted during runs - Offscreen heartbeat keeps runs ticking in throttled background tabs - Live progress in the panel **and on the toolbar badge** (green count = clean, amber = some failures, ✓ / ✕ flash when the run ends) ### Downloads - Auto-downloads every generated image/video; style & ratio folded into the prompt | | **Gemini** | T2I · I2I · T2V · I2V | model (Pro/Flash), image/video tool toggle; style & ratio via prompt | | **ChatGPT** | T2I · I2I | model (Auto/Instant/Thinking), Create-image tool; style & ratio via prompt | | **Qwen** | T2I · I2I · T2V · I2V | model (Qwen3 Max/Plus/VL), image/video tool toggle; style & ratio via prompt | | **Vibes.ai** | T2I · I2I · T2V · I2V · ING2V | model (Auto/Quality/Fast), style (Photorealistic/Cinematic/Anime/Illustration), video duration (4/6/8/10 s), quality (Standard/HD/4K); # 🚀 Meta AI Automation — Batch Prompts & Auto-Download for Meta.ai

> **Run hundreds of Meta.ai prompts on autopilot.** Batch-generate AI videos and images on [meta.ai/media](https://www.meta.ai/media), then download every result hands-free.

**Language:** **English** · [中文](i18n/README_zh.md) · [Español](i18n/README_es.md) · [हिन्दी](i18n/README_hi.md) · [Português (BR)](i18n/README_pt-BR.md) · [العربية](i18n/README_ar.md) · [Русский](i18n/README_ru.md) · [日本語](i18n/README_ja.md) · [Deutsch](i18n/README_de.md) · [Français](i18n/README_fr.md) · [한국어](i18n/README_ko.md) · [Italiano](i18n/README_it.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](i18n/README_id.md) · [Türkçe](i18n/README_tr.md) · [Tiếng Việt](i18n/README_vi.md) · [Polski](i18n/README_pl.md) · [Nederlands](i18n/README_nl.md) · [ไทย](i18n/README_th.md) · [繁體中文](i18n/README_zh-TW.md) · [Українська](i18n/README_uk.md) · [Filipino](i18n/README_fil.md) · [Bahasa Melayu](i18n/README_ms.md) · [Română](i18n/README_ro.md) · [Svenska](i18n/README_sv.md) · [Čeština](i18n/README_cs.md) · [Ελληνικά](i18n/README_el.md) · [Magyar](i18n/README_hu.md) · [Dansk](i18n/README_da.md) · [Suomi](i18n/README_fi.md) · [Slovenčina](i18n/README_sk.md) · [Norsk Bokmål](i18n/README_nb.md) · [Hrvatski](i18n/README_hr.md) · [Català](i18n/README_ca.md) · [Kiswahili](i18n/README_sw.md) · [Azərbaycan](i18n/README_az.md) · [Afrikaans](i18n/README_af.md) · [Lietuvių](i18n/README_lt.md) · [Latviešu](i18n/README_lv.md) · [Eesti](i18n/README_et.md) · [isiZulu](i18n/README_zu.md) · [Galego](i18n/README_gl.md) · [Euskara](i18n/README_eu.md) · [Íslenska](i18n/README_is.md) · [Gaeilge](i18n/README_ga.md) · [Cymraeg](i18n/README_cy.md)

---

**Meta AI Automation** is a Chrome extension that turns **Meta.ai** into a hands-free **batch video and image generator**. Instead of pasting prompts one at a time and babysitting each generation, you load your whole list, press **Run**, and the extension auto-submits every prompt, waits for Meta.ai to finish, and saves each video or image into tidy project folders.

If you produce AI content at scale — short-form video, social clips, product shots, ad creative, or storyboards — **Meta AI Automation** removes the repetitive clicking. Queue a full batch, walk away, and come back to a folder full of finished files.

- 🌐 **Website:** [Official site](https://github.com/amzbase-com/meta-ai-automation-extension)
- 🧩 **Install:** [Meta AI Automation on the Chrome Web Store]({{EXTENSION_URL}}?hl=en)

---

## ✨ Key Features

* **🚀 Batch prompt automation:** Queue dozens or hundreds of prompts in a single run. The extension submits each one to Meta.ai and drives generation from start to finish — no manual clicking.
* **🎬 Text-to-Video automation:** Turn written descriptions into videos in bulk, with configurable delays so long queues stay within Meta.ai limits.
* **🎞️ Image-to-Video:** Bring a still image to life — pair a source image with prompts to generate motion clips automatically.
* **🖼️ Text-to-Image batching:** Generate many images at once across aspect ratios **16:9, 9:16, and 1:1**.
* **🎨 Image-to-Image variations:** Restyle or remix an existing image into new versions using text prompts.
* **⚡ Concurrent prompts:** Run several prompts in parallel to clear large batches faster.
* **⏱️ Smart delays:** Set custom intervals between submissions to avoid rate limits on big jobs.
* **⬇️ Auto-download:** Automatically save finished videos and images to your computer the moment they're ready.
* **📂 Project folders:** Sort every download into per-project subfolders so your library stays organized.
* **📊 Real-time queue monitor:** Track progress live in the Chrome **Side Panel** with a visual status bar and active-prompt list.
* **🌐 Multi-language UI:** Use the extension in your own language.

---

## 🎯 Who Is It For?

| Creator | How Meta AI Automation helps |
| :--- | :--- |
| **🎥 Short-form video makers** | Batch-produce Reels, Shorts, and TikTok scenes with Text-to-Video. |
| **📱 Social media managers** | Mass-generate on-brand clips and images for a full content calendar. |
| **🛍️ E-commerce & product teams** | Turn product photos into motion clips and image variations at scale. |
| **📈 Marketing & ad creatives** | Spin up A/B creative variations for campaigns in minutes, not hours. |
| **🎨 AI artists & hobbyists** | Explore prompt ideas in bulk without manual submit-and-wait loops. |

---

## 🎬 Generation Modes

Meta AI Automation supports all **four Meta.ai media modes**:

1. **Text-to-Video** — generate videos from text prompts.
2. **Image-to-Video** — animate a source image with prompts.
3. **Text-to-Image** — generate images from text prompts (16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1).
4. **Image-to-Image** — transform an existing image into new variations.

---

## 📥 Installation

### Chrome Web Store (Recommended)

1. Open the [Meta AI Automation listing]({{EXTENSION_URL}}?hl=en) on the Chrome Web Store.
2. Click **Add to Chrome**.
3. Pin the extension icon to your toolbar for quick access.

Works on Chrome and Chromium-based browsers such as Edge, Brave, and Arc.

---

## 📖 User Guide

### Getting Started

1. **Open Meta.ai.** Go to [meta.ai/media](https://www.meta.ai/media) (or [meta.ai](https://www.meta.ai)) and make sure you're signed in.
2. **Open the extension.** Click the Meta AI Automation icon in your Chrome toolbar — pin it for easy access.
3. **Configure your batch.** In the **Control** tab, set:
   - **Concurrent Prompts** — how many prompts run at the same time.
   - **Prompt Delay** — wait time between submissions, to manage rate limits.
   - **Auto-Download** — toggle hands-free saving when each result finishes.

# OCDW — OmniRoute + Claude Desktop Workstation

My personal setup, config and docs for running **[OmniRoute](https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute)** (free, self-hosted AI gateway) together with **Claude Desktop** on a Windows machine.

> **Note on the old plan:** this repo was originally created for a GitHub-Actions-based RDP tunnel. That approach violates GitHub's Acceptable Use Policies (Actions minutes are for build/test/deploy only, not general-purpose remote desktops) and risks account suspension, so it has been dropped. Everything here runs on hardware you actually control — your own PC, or a legit cloud VM.

---

## What this gives you

| Piece | Role |
| --- | --- |
| **OmniRoute** | Local AI gateway on `localhost:20128`. One OpenAI-compatible endpoint in front of 260+ providers (90+ with a free tier), with quota-aware auto-fallback and token compression. |
| **Claude Desktop** | The client / UI. Connects to OmniRoute two ways — as an **MCP server** (tools) and/or as a **third-party inference gateway** (models). |

Request path:

```
Claude Desktop  ──►  OmniRoute (localhost:20128)  ──►  268 providers
     (client)            (router + fallback)            (Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi…)
```

---

## Quick start

```powershell
# 1. Install + run OmniRoute (Node 20+ required)
npm install -g omniroute
$env:INITIAL_PASSWORD = "<pick-a-strong-password>"   # IMPORTANT: default admin password is literally CHANGEME
omniroute

# 2. Dashboard opens at http://localhost:20128 — add providers / API keys there

# 3. Sanity check
omniroute doctor
```

Then follow **[docs/02-claude-desktop.md](docs/02-claude-desktop.md)** to wire Claude Desktop into it.

---

## Repo layout

```
docs/
  01-omniroute-setup.md      # install, first run, providers, hardening
  02-claude-desktop.md       # connecting Claude Desktop (MCP + gateway)
config/
  claude_desktop_config.example.json
scripts/
  install-omniroute.ps1      # one-shot Windows installer helper
```

---

## Ground rules for this repo

- ❌ Never commit API keys, tokens or passwords. Use `.env` (git-ignored) or the OmniRoute dashboard.
- ❌ No CI abuse — no RDP tunnels, no crypto mining, no long-running Actions jobs.
- ✅ Everything must be reproducible from the docs in this repo.

# 🤖 Claude Code Telegram Bridge

> **Real Claude Code CLI** on Telegram, via a local Anthropic→OpenAI translation proxy.
> Backend: GLM served by Z.AI internal proxy.

---

## 📑 Table of Contents

1. [What This Is](#-what-this-is)
2. [How It Works](#-how-it-works)
3. [Quick Start](#-quick-start)
4. [Architecture](#-architecture)
5. [Commands](#-commands)
6. [Configuration](#-configuration)
7. [24/7 Operation](#-247-operation)
8. [Example Tasks](#-example-tasks)
9. [How It Differs From v4](#-how-it-differs-from-v4)
10. [Troubleshooting](#-troubleshooting)
11. [Limitations](#-limitations)

---

## 🎯 What This Is

This is a **Telegram bot that runs the actual Claude Code CLI** (the official Anthropic
coding agent) on your server. Instead of using Anthropic's API, it routes requests
through a local proxy that translates Anthropic Messages API → OpenAI Chat Completions,
forwarding them to the **Z.AI internal proxy** which serves GLM.

### Why this matters

- ✅ **Real Claude Code** — the official `claude` binary with all its tools (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, etc.)
- ✅ **Single backend** — GLM via Z.AI proxy. No fake model picker, no fallback confusion.
- ✅ **24/7 operation** via supervisor + auto-restart
- ✅ **Multi-modal** — text, images, voice (with transcription), files
- ✅ **Telegram-native** — send tasks from your phone, get responses back

---

## 🔧 How It Works

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    You (Telegram)                            │
│  Send message: "Build me a Python web scraper"              │
└──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘
                           ↓
              ┌────────────┴────────────┐
              │  tg_bridge.ts (Bot)     │
              │  • Polls TG every 25s   │
              │  • Handles commands     │
              │  • Spawns Claude Code   │
              └────────────┬────────────┘
                           ↓
              ┌────────────┴────────────┐
              │  Claude Code CLI 2.1.x  │
              │  • Bash, Read, Write    │
              │  • Edit, Glob, Grep     │
              │  • Multi-step agent     │
              │  --print --bare mode    │
              └────────────┬────────────┘
                           ↓
              ┌────────────┴────────────┐
              │  anthropic_proxy.ts     │
              │  (local HTTP server)    │
              │  Translates:            │
              │  Anthropic /v1/messages │
              │      ↓                  │
              │  OpenAI /v1/chat/comp   │
              └────────────┬────────────┘
                           ↓
              ┌────────────┴────────────┐
              │  Z.AI Internal Proxy    │
              │  internal-api.z.ai/v1   │
              │  Serves: GLM            │
              └────────────┬────────────┘
                           ↓
              ┌────────────┴────────────┐
              │  GLM Model              │
              │  (Zhipu AI)             │
              └─────────────────────────┘
```

### The Anthropic-to-OpenAI Translation

Claude Code speaks the **Anthropic Messages API** format. The Z.AI proxy speaks the
**OpenAI Chat Completions** format. The `anthropic_proxy.ts` server bridges them:

1. Receives Anthropic-format requests from Claude Code
2. Translates messages, tools, tool_choice to OpenAI format
3. Forwards to Z.AI proxy
4. Translates response back to Anthropic format
5. Returns to Claude Code

Works for: text generation, tool calling (Bash, Read, Write, Edit), streaming SSE, vision, system prompts.

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites

2. **Claude Code CLI** — `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`

# Z.AI Autonomous Agent v2.0 — Devin-Style AI Developer

> Fully autonomous, 24/7 continuous AI web developer that plans, codes, deploys, and self-improves projects — all within the z.ai sandbox using only cron jobs.

**One command starts a project. The AI does everything else.**

```
python3 task_manager.py plan "Build an e-commerce website with dark theme"
```

The Manager AI breaks this into 20-30 micro-tasks, the Worker AI executes them (creates files, runs commands, writes code), and the Maintainer AI keeps improving forever.

---

## How It Works (Architecture)

```
User: "Build an e-commerce website"
         │
         ▼
┌─── PHASE 1: MANAGER AI ────────────────────────────┐
│  Analyzes request → Generates 20-30 micro-tasks    │
│  (mkdir, npm install, create HTML/CSS/JS, etc.)     │
│  Adds all to queue with dependencies                │
└─────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┘
              ▼
┌─── PHASE 2: WORKER AI ─────────────────────────────┐
│  Picks next task (dependency-aware, priority-sorted) │
│  Executes: file_create, file_edit, cli_run, review   │
│  On error: AI analyzes stderr → generates fix        │
│  Records results in memory (files, lessons, state)   │
└─────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┘
              ▼
┌─── PHASE 3: MAINTAINER AI ─────────────────────────┐
│  Queue empty? Project done? → Self-improvement loop  │
│  Reads architecture.md + roadmap.md                  │
│  Generates improvement tasks (SEO, UX, perf, etc.)   │
│  The agent NEVER stops working                       │
└─────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┘
              ▼
┌─── PHASE 4: MEMORY ────────────────────────────────┐
│  Updates project_state.json (files, lessons, state)  │
│  Updates architecture.md (change log)                │
│  Updates roadmap.md (completed + planned features)    │
│  Next cycle loads ALL this context → AI "remembers"  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 4 Core Modules

### 1. Manager (`agent_manager.py`) — Self-Queueing & Auto-Planning
- User says "Build X" → Manager AI thinks like a Senior Architect
- Breaks into 20-30 atomic micro-tasks with dependencies
- Respects execution order (setup → structure → code → review)
- Creates project in memory with full metadata

### 2. Worker (`agent_worker.py`) — Direct File System & CLI Execution
- **file_create**: AI generates content → writes to disk
- **file_edit**: Reads file → AI modifies → writes back
- **cli_run**: Executes commands (npm, pip, mkdir, etc.) → handles errors
- **Error Recovery**: Command fails → AI reads stderr → generates fix → retries
- **Lessons Learned**: Failed patterns stored in memory, never repeated

### 3. Memory (`agent_memory.py`) — Long-Term "Brain"
- **project_state.json**: Files created, packages installed, commands run, lessons learned
- **architecture.md**: Auto-maintained change log (grows with every cycle)
- **roadmap.md**: Planned + completed features
- **Every cycle starts by loading memory** → AI knows everything done before
- Even after 2 months, the AI remembers the full project history

### 4. Maintainer (`agent_maintainer.py`) — Infinite Improvement Loop
- Queue empty + project done → Maintainer activates
- Reads project files, architecture, roadmap
- Generates 2-3 improvement tasks per cycle (SEO, UX, performance, refactoring)
- **The agent never stops** — it continuously improves

- Use single-shot scripts that complete quickly

### Step 2: Run Workflow

1. Go to **Actions** tab
2. Select desired workflow (Linux/Windows/macOS)
3. Click **Run workflow**
4. Wait for initialization (~3-5 minutes)

#### For Linux/macOS (VNC):
```bash
# Step 1: Run on your LOCAL machine
cloudflared access tcp --hostname <HOSTNAME_FROM_LOGS> --url 127.0.0.1:5902

# Step 2: Open VNC Viewer and connect to:
# Server: localhost:5902
# Password: P@ssw0rd123! (or your VNC_PASSWORD secret)
```

#### For Windows (RDP):
```bash
# Step 1: Run on your LOCAL machine
cloudflared access tcp --hostname <HOSTNAME_FROM_LOGS> --url 127.0.0.1:3389

# Server: localhost:3389

```

## 🔄 Backup System

### How It Works

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│             BACKUP WATCHER v2.0 ARCHITECTURE                │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                             │
│  ~/Desktop/workspace/     ──────►  inotifywait/fswatch     │
│  ├── project-1/                    (real-time monitor)      │
│  ├── project-2/                           │                 │
│  └── project-3/                           ▼                 │
│                                    Periodic Scan            │
│                                    (every 5 min)            │
│                                           │                 │
│                                           ▼                 │
│                                    GitHub API               │
│                                    (create repo)            │
│                                           │                 │
│                                           ▼                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────► github.com           │

| 📋 **Tracked File** | Avoids duplicate backups |
| 🔒 **Private Repos** | All backups are private by default |
| 📂 **Index Repository** | `backup-files` repo tracks all backed up projects |

When you start a new workflow session:
1. Workflow checks for `backup-files` repository
2. Reads the project list from README.md

# UnQOps

[![UnQOps: AI-Powered Full-Stack Web Development in the Browser](./public/social_preview.jpg)](https://unqops.pages.dev)

**UnQOps** is a powerful, open-source AI-powered full-stack web development platform that runs entirely in your browser. Build complete web applications using natural language prompts with support for multiple AI models and providers.

## 🚀 Key Features

- **🤖 Multi-LLM Support**: Choose from OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, OpenRouter, Gemini, LMStudio, Mistral, xAI, HuggingFace, DeepSeek, Groq, and more
- **🌐 Browser-Based Development**: Complete development environment with no local setup required
- **📁 Project Management**: Create, edit, and manage full-stack applications
- **🔄 Real-time Preview**: Instant preview of your applications as you build
- **💾 Multiple Export Options**: Download as ZIP, deploy to Netlify, or sync to github and local folders
- **🖼️ Visual Context**: Attach images to prompts for better AI understanding
- **📱 Mobile Friendly**: Responsive design that works on all devices
- **🔧 Integrated Terminal**: Full terminal access with streaming command output
- **⚡ Hot Reload**: Real-time updates and live reloading

## 🎯 Perfect For

- **Rapid Prototyping**: Quickly build and test ideas
- **Learning & Education**: Perfect for students and developers learning new technologies
- **Client Demos**: Create impressive prototypes for client presentations
- **Hackathons**: Fast development cycles for competitive coding
- **Proof of Concepts**: Validate ideas before full development

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Option 1: Instant Deployment (Recommended)

Deploy UnQOps to Cloudflare Pages with one click:

[![Deploy to Cloudflare Pages](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/button)](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/?url=https://github.com/Sandeepgaddam5432/UnQOps)

### Option 2: Local Development

#### Prerequisites
- Node.js 18+ ([Download here](https://nodejs.org/))
- pnpm package manager

#### Installation Steps

1. **Clone the repository**:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/Sandeepgaddam5432/UnQOps.git
   cd UnQOps
   ```

2. **Install dependencies**:
   ```bash
   npm install -g pnpm
   pnpm install
   ```

3. **Start development server**:
   ```bash
   pnpm run dev
   ```

4. **Open your browser** and navigate to `http://localhost:5173`

### Option 3: Docker Deployment

For containerized deployment:

```bash
# Build the image
docker build . --target unqops-development

# Run with Docker Compose
docker compose --profile development up
```

## 🔑 Configuration

### Setting Up API Keys

1. Open UnQOps in your browser
2. Click the provider dropdown in the interface
3. Select your preferred AI provider
4. Click the edit (pencil) icon
5. Enter your API key securely

### Supported AI Providers

| Provider | Models Available | Custom Base URL |
|----------|------------------|-----------------|
| **OpenAI** | GPT-4, GPT-3.5, etc. | ✅ |
| **Anthropic** | Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3 Opus | ✅ |
| **Google** | Gemini Pro, Gemini Ultra | ❌ |
| **Ollama** | Llama 2, CodeLlama, Mistral | ✅ |
| **Groq** | Llama 2, Mixtral | ✅ |
| **DeepSeek** | DeepSeek Coder | ✅ |
| **xAI** | Grok Beta | ❌ |
| **HuggingFace** | Various OSS models | ✅ |
| **LM Studio** | Local models | ✅ |

### Custom Base URLs

For providers supporting custom endpoints:

1. Click the settings icon in the sidebar
2. Navigate to "Providers" tab
3. Search for your provider
4. Enter your custom base URL

## 📦 Deployment Options

### Cloudflare Pages (Recommended)

UnQOps is optimized for Cloudflare Pages deployment:

1. **One-Click Deploy**: Use the deploy button above
2. **Manual Deploy**: 
   - Fork this repository
   - Connect your GitHub account to Cloudflare Pages
   - Select the repository and deploy

### Netlify

Deploy directly to Netlify from the UnQOps interface:

1. Build your application in UnQOps
2. Click the "Deploy to Netlify" button
3. Follow the deployment wizard

### Local Export

- **ZIP Download**: Download your complete project as a ZIP file
- **Folder Sync**: Sync projects to a local directory for further development
- **GitHub Integration**: Push projects directly to GitHub repositories

## 🛠️ Development Scripts

```bash
# Development
pnpm run dev              # Start development server
pnpm run build            # Build for production
pnpm run preview          # Preview production build

# Testing & Quality
pnpm test                 # Run test suite
pnpm run typecheck        # TypeScript type checking
pnpm run lint:fix         # Fix linting issues

# Deployment
pnpm run build          # Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
pnpm run start            # Run production build locally
```

## 🏗️ Architecture

UnQOps is built with modern web technologies:

- **Frontend**: React + Vite + TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Runtime**: WebContainers API for browser-based execution
- **AI Integration**: Vercel AI SDK for multi-provider support
- **Deployment**: Cloudflare Pages + Workers

## 🤝 Contributing

3. Commit your changes: `git commit -m 'Add amazing feature'`
4. Push to the branch: `git push origin feature/amazing-feature`
5. Open a Pull Request

See our [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) for detailed guidelines.

- Team collaboration features
